candidates.thesis: The product is a tool for a weekly ritual, so the page behaves like a printed schedule: grid, rules, restrained type.
candidates.composition: 12-column ledger grid with visible rules; hero is a single week row, not a centred headline stack.
candidates.typeMove: one serif for headings, tabular numerals for every figure, no display weights
candidates.palette: ink on paper white plus one signal red used only for the current day
antiReferences: centred hero with a giant adjective

candidates.thesis: The product removes coordination overhead, so the page shows two people agreeing in one screen rather than describing features.
candidates.composition: split pane that mirrors two calendars and closes the gap between them on scroll
candidates.typeMove: two type sizes only; hierarchy through alignment, not weight
candidates.palette: two dark neutrals and a shared-state highlight, no accent colour for decoration

candidates.thesis: The product is trustworthy because it is boring on purpose, so the page reads like documentation with a single worked example.
candidates.composition: single measured column with a live example pinned beside each claim
candidates.typeMove: one grotesk at three sizes, code-grade line height, generous leading
candidates.palette: monochrome with a single focus outline colour reused from the product

decision.why: The brief names coordination cost as the job, and c2 shows the cost disappearing instead of asserting it; c1's ritual framing is a real idea but asks the reader to accept a metaphor before any evidence.

rejected.reason: the metaphor needs explaining on a page with eight seconds of attention
documentation framing undersells the one-motion demo the brief asks for

antiReferences: no claim without a visible mechanism on the same screen

imagery.rationale: The product sells a quieter week, so a single real photograph of a working desk at dusk carries the claim better than three flat illustrations shape a page.
imagery.fallback: Type-only fallback: the hero becomes the week-row component with no image, budget 0 bytes.
